comment: Shared static-rendering diagnostic codes. Both independent renderers emit only these codes for the same conditions; messages stay implementation-specific. Capability limits (plugins, migrations, full CSL) are declared per renderer in its capability record, not as diagnostic codes.

codes.invalid-math: Math input was rejected or failed to render; the source TeX stays visible with the shared publisle-math-error class.
codes.unsafe-url: An unsafe URL was removed from output.
codes.unresolved-reference: A cross-reference names no known label; the reference text stays in place.
codes.unresolved-footnote: A footnote reference names no known note.
codes.unresolved-citation: A citation names no bibliography entry.
codes.fallback-inline: Unsupported inline content is preserved as readable text.
codes.fallback-readable: A block without a portable static representation is rendered through its authored or readable fallback.
codes.unsupported-block-version: The renderer does not implement this block schema version; no migration ran and the readable association is used.
codes.unresolved-readable-binding: A readable association binding could not be resolved against the block data.
codes.missing-renderer: No renderer is registered for a block type.
codes.missing-static-representation: A registered renderer exposes no static representation.
codes.missing-diagram-renderer: No renderer supplies the referenced diagram engine.
codes.diagram-render-failed: The diagram engine failed; source and authored fallback are used.
codes.missing-embed-provider: The embed provider is not registered; fallback content is used.
codes.missing-island-renderer: No interactive implementation is registered for the block type.
codes.raw-html-placement-unscoped: Raw HTML placement is only valid inside a scoped placement.
